about: Tracked files that still carry internal planning words, with the number of findings each may have. scripts/project-docs.test.mjs (or the repo test that runs the ratchet) fails when a file that is not listed gets one or a count grows; a lower count passes. Lower the list with: node scripts/security/secret-scan.mjs --tracked --ratchet --shrink. Never add a file or raise a count.
